feeds.title: Charlotte Parent
feeds.description: Charlotte Parent is made for parents -- local, engaged, involved. Known as the most trusted family resource in the area for 30+ years, our website, newsletters, social media channels and annual print guides are created to help make life easier for parents. We are a one-stop parenting resource, with a daily calendar of events, locally generated stories, area guides & directories that are updated year-round and so much more.

feeds.title: Carolina Charm
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Christina, the author behind Carolina Charm. I'm the wife to Matt and a coffee-fueled mama to Caroline and Thomas. This is a space for me to share the moments that make my mama's heart spill over, a mix of recipes, and more. My hope is you will find something in this space that encourages, entertains or inspires you.

feeds.title: NC Farm Families Blog
feeds.description: The Farmkeepers is the official blog of NC Farm Families. It is here that words will flow, our voice will be heard, a stand will be made, and the farm families of North Carolina will be protected. In these posts, we'll set the record straight. You'll see the faces of the families who feed us. Here, you'll receive all the updates and news. It is here that we will fight for farmers and be the keepers of the farm in NC. We hope you'll join us. Follow along on social media and by joining our email list.

feeds.title: Raleigh Family Adventure
feeds.description: Hello! Welcome to Raleigh Family Adventure, a website dedicated to sharing the best family fun in the Triangle region of North Carolina.

feeds.title: Baptist Children's Homes of North Carolina Blog
feeds.description: Baptist Children's Homes of North Carolina is a collection of ministries united by a common goal of providing hope through Jesus Christ to children, families, and adults in need. The BCH blog regularly shares stories and insights related to the challenges faced by vulnerable populations and the ways in which they are being served. I encourage you to read these stories of hope and gain a better understanding of the important work being done by this organization.

feeds.title: Thompson Child & Family Focus
feeds.description: Thompson is a human services leader transforming lives through early childhood, family stability, and mental health services. As a solutions-driven organization committed to rewriting narratives for the most vulnerable in our community; Thompson achieves this by providing comprehensive, evidence-based services, and trauma-informed care, for children (ages 0-18) and their families, virtually and in-person.

feeds.title: Thriller Mom Blog
feeds.description: A collection of blog posts dedicated to adventure, family travel, parenting, wellness, & womanhood.

feeds.title: Culbertson and Associates Blog
feeds.description: Drawing upon more than 25 years of legal experience, Krispen Culbertson is an attorney and senior partner at the law firm Culbertson & Associates.

feeds.title: Forsyth Family Magazine
feeds.description: Forsyth Family Magazine is a positively inspired, community-focused publication based in Winston-Salem, NC. A new issue comes out every month! We love keeping our community connected. Want your free copy? Check out our find a copy tool!

feeds.title: Wilmington Mom
feeds.description: Welcome to WilmingtonMom, Your Ultimate Guide to Parenting and Family Life in Wilmington, North Carolina. Discover the best of Wilmington through the eyes of a local family. This will be your go-to resource for everything family-related in our beautiful coastal city.

feeds.title: The Banana Moon Blog
feeds.description: The Banana Moon is a Lifestyle Blog written by Kiara Ruth. There she will write about her motherhood. The Banana Moon is blog home to Mommy Blogger Kiara Ruth. She blogs about motherhood, food, style, life relationships, culture and things to do in North Carolina.

feeds.title: North Carolina Yoga Girl
feeds.description: 'North Carolina Yoga Girl' is a blog that focuses on personal fitness, health, lifestyle, and yoga. The blog is run by women.
